tablet.notes:
Message bubbles stop at about three quarters of the width, like Google Messages, instead of running from one side of the screen to the other.
The keyboard goes away when you press its Done or Search key (search boxes, name and PIN fields, the pairing code).
Since the last update: messages from the same person are stacked like Google Messages.
